001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv;
002
003import com.opencsv.CSVReader;
004import com.opencsv.CSVWriter;
005import com.opencsv.exceptions.CsvValidationException;
006import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
007import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
008import com.streamconverter.path.CSVPath;
009import com.streamconverter.path.IColumnSelector;
010import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.io.InputStream;
013import java.io.InputStreamReader;
014import java.io.OutputStream;
015import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
016import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
017import java.util.List;
018
019/**
020 * CSV Walker
021 *
022 * <p>This class implements command for targeted CSV transformation using column selectors. It
023 * identifies specific columns using column names or indices and applies IRule transformations to
024 * those columns while preserving the overall CSV structure.
025 */
026public class CsvWalker implements IStreamCommand {
027
028  private final IColumnSelector columnSelector;
029  private final IRule rule;
030
031  /**
032   * Constructor for CSV navigation with typed column selector and transformation rule.
033   *
034   * @param columnSelector the typed IColumnSelector to select columns
035   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected columns
036   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector or rule is null
037   */
038  private CsvWalker(IColumnSelector columnSelector, IRule rule) {
039    this.columnSelector = columnSelector;
040    this.rule = rule;
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Constructor for CSV navigation with TreePath (for compatibility).
045   *
046   * @param treePath the TreePath representing column selector
047   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column
048   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
049   */
050  private CsvWalker(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
051    this.columnSelector = CSVPath.of(treePath.toString());
052    this.rule = rule;
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Factory method for creating a CSV navigation command with typed column selector and rule.
057   *
058   * @param columnSelector the typed IColumnSelector to select columns
059   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected columns
060   * @return a CsvWalker that transforms values in the specified columns using the given rule
061   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector or rule is null
062   */
063  public static CsvWalker create(IColumnSelector columnSelector, IRule rule) {
064    if (columnSelector == null) {
065      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selector cannot be null");
066    }
067    if (rule == null) {
068      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
069    }
070    return new CsvWalker(columnSelector, rule);
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Factory method for creating a CSV walker with TreePath compatibility.
075   *
076   * @param treePath the TreePath representing column selector
077   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column data
078   * @return a CsvWalker that transforms values in the specified column using the given rule
079   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
080   */
081  public static CsvWalker create(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
082    if (treePath == null) {
083      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
084    }
085    if (rule == null) {
086      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
087    }
088    return new CsvWalker(treePath, rule);
089  }
090
091  @Override
092  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
093    try (CSVReader csvReader =
094            new CSVReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
095        CSVWriter csvWriter =
096            new CSVWriter(
097                new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
098                CSVWriter.DEFAULT_SEPARATOR,
099                CSVWriter.DEFAULT_QUOTE_CHARACTER,
100                // RFC 4180 §5: only doubled-quote escaping, no backslash escape
101                CSVWriter.NO_ESCAPE_CHARACTER,
102                // RFC4180_LINE_END (\r\n) per RFC 4180 §2.
103                CSVWriter.RFC4180_LINE_END)) {
104
105      applyRuleToColumn(csvReader, csvWriter);
106
107    } catch (CsvValidationException e) {
108      throw new IOException("Failed to parse CSV: " + e.getMessage(), e);
109    }
110  }
111
112  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
113  // IRule.apply() declares no checked exceptions; any RuntimeException must be caught and
114  // re-thrown as IOException so the caller's error-handling path is not bypassed.
115  private void applyRuleToColumn(CSVReader csvReader, CSVWriter csvWriter)
116      throws IOException, CsvValidationException {
117    String[] headers = csvReader.readNext();
118    if (headers == null) {
119      return; // Empty input
120    }
121
122    List<Integer> indices = columnSelector.resolve(headers);
123    if (indices.isEmpty()) {
124      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column not found: " + columnSelector.toString());
125    }
126
127    // Write header (unchanged); applyQuotesToAll=false: only quote when RFC 4180 requires
128    csvWriter.writeNext(headers, false);
129
130    // Process data rows
131    String[] row;
132    while ((row = csvReader.readNext()) != null) {
133      for (int idx : indices) {
134        if (idx < row.length) {
135          String transformed;
136          try {
137            transformed = rule.apply(row[idx]);
138          } catch (RuntimeException ruleEx) {
139            throw new IOException("Rule application failed at column index " + idx, ruleEx);
140          }
141          row[idx] = transformed;
142        }
143      }
144      // applyQuotesToAll=false: only quote fields that contain delimiters or quotes
145      csvWriter.writeNext(row, false);
146    }
147    csvWriter.flush();
148  }
149}
